Watch Meendum Meendum Tamil Short Film (மீண்டும் மீண்டும்).

Synopsis
A man is haunted by a doorbell that rings every night at 2:30 AM, but no one is ever there. As a police investigation unfolds, they uncover a dark secret from the past—but the terrifying ringing just won't stop.

Star Cast:
Manoj – Lead Protagonist
VJ (Nagendra Kumar J) – Police Inspector
Shashank - Friend
Sathish - Constable
DK Suriya Narayanan – Food delivery person

STORY, SCREENPLAY, DIRECTION : D K Suriya Narayanan
